newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Comerica, Bank of New York.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Comerica, Bank of New York.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it downgraded both Comerica Inc and Bank of New York Co Inc to neutral from outperform.
-- On Bank of New York, Lehman said in a report, "We have grown lukewarm to the stock due to the bank's recent misfortunes in its credit card business." The stock slipped 1/4 to 29-1/8.
-- As for Comerica, Lehman said "since upgraded two years ago, the stock has almost doubled, a P/E discount has become a slight premium and our theme of strong loan growth has somewhat played out."
